figures.name: Metatron

ability.name: Divine Dictation
ability.description: Copy and store all information on the field; use stored info to predict enemy next action.

figures.description: Greatest of archangels, once the human Enoch, who writes down all divine decrees and guards the throne.

figures.name: Lilith

ability.name: First Refusal
ability.description: Lilith cannot be controlled, charmed or enslaved by any effect; deal 4 dark damage.

figures.description: Adam's first wife who refused subjugation and became a fearsome night demon who haunts the dark.

figures.name: Samael

ability.name: Angel of Death
ability.description: Mark one enemy: they will be destroyed at the start of your next turn.

figures.description: The angel of death and the accuser whose name means 'Poison of God,' associated with Rome and destruction.

figures.name: Sandalphon

ability.name: Prayer Tower
ability.description: All prayer and healing abilities gain +3 power while Sandalphon stands.

figures.description: The tallest angel whose height spans heaven and earth, who weaves the prayers of Israel into crowns for God.

figures.name: Golem

ability.name: Emet (Truth)
ability.description: Become unstoppable: cannot be debuffed or slowed; deal 6 damage. Remove Emet: destroy Golem.

figures.description: Clay giant animated by the divine name, created by the Rabbi of Prague to protect the Jewish community.

figures.name: Azazel

ability.name: Scapegoat's Burden
ability.description: Transfer all debuffs on your allies to one enemy.

figures.description: Fallen angel leader of the Watchers who taught humanity forbidden knowledge and dwells in the desert wilderness.

figures.name: Gabriel

ability.name: Revelation Trumpet
ability.description: Reveal all hidden information on the field; grant +3 to all allied angels.

figures.description: The angel of divine revelation who announced the birth of Isaac and interpreted Daniel's visions.

figures.name: Michael

ability.name: Heavenly Host
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 defense; deal 5 damage to dark/chaos enemies from heavenly war.

figures.description: Chief warrior angel and protector of Israel who leads the heavenly armies against the forces of evil.

figures.name: Behemoth

ability.name: Primal Might
ability.description: This card cannot be moved, pushed or repositioned by any ability.

figures.description: The colossal chaos creature of the land created alongside Leviathan at the beginning of time.

figures.name: Leviathan (Hebrew)

ability.name: Primordial Sea
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; enemies cannot use sea or water abilities against this card.

figures.description: The great sea monster of chaos whom God slays at the end of time, whose flesh will feast the righteous.

figures.name: Raphael

ability.name: Divine Medicine
ability.description: Fully remove all disease, poison and curse effects from all allies.

figures.description: The healing archangel who traveled with Tobias in disguise and taught the secrets of all healing.

figures.name: Uriel

ability.name: Light of Uriel
ability.description: Illuminate: no dark abilities may be hidden or disguised for 2 turns.

figures.description: The angel of light and fire who guards Eden's gate and oversees the souls of the departed.

figures.name: Asmodeus

ability.name: Demon King's Compulsion
ability.description: Force one enemy to waste their most powerful ability on themselves.

figures.description: King of demons who rules the sin of lust and who was bound by Raphael with incense fish liver and gall.

figures.name: Naamah

ability.name: Night Terror
ability.description: Inflict sleep on one enemy; they take 3 additional damage from any source while asleep.

figures.description: The female demon of seduction, sister of Tubal-Cain, who joins Lilith in haunting the night.

figures.name: Ziz

ability.name: Wing Shadow
ability.description: Block all light and sun abilities for 1 turn with Ziz's enormous wings.

figures.description: The colossal primordial bird of the sky whose wingspan can block the sun, counterpart to Behemoth and Leviathan.

figures.name: Angel of the Lord

ability.name: Divine Manifestation
ability.description: This card's true identity is hidden; enemies cannot counter what they cannot identify.

figures.description: The mysterious Angel of the Lord who appears in human or fire form and speaks with the full authority of God.

figures.name: Dumah

ability.name: Veil of Silence
ability.description: Silence all enemy abilities for 1 turn; they cannot use special moves.

figures.description: The angel of silence who guards the realm of the dead and who stands at the entrance to Sheol.

figures.name: Azrael

ability.name: Soul Separation
ability.description: Gently remove one friendly dying ally from battle; they cannot be returned or destroyed — only peacefully ended.

figures.description: The Islamic and Jewish angel of death who takes souls from bodies with perfect gentleness.

figures.name: Elijah's Chariot

ability.name: Whirlwind Ascent
ability.description: Any ally can fly to heaven for 1 turn: they become immune to all ground attacks.

figures.description: The fiery chariot that carried the prophet Elijah to heaven without tasting death.

figures.name: Shedim

ability.name: Lesser Plague
ability.description: Inflict a random minor debuff on all enemies simultaneously.

figures.description: The legions of lesser demons who inhabit desolate places, causing disease and misfortune.
